newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti opens down after new debt figure.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti opens down after new debt figure.

text.p: Shares in information technology company Olivetti dropped 6.48 percent at the opening on Tuesday after the company announced a sharp deterioration in its financial position on Monday night.
Olivetti shares were quoted at 525 lire just after the opening bell.
Olivetti said in a statement last night net financial indebtedness leapt to 2.39 trillion lire at end-August from 1.26 trillion at the end of June.

The company's shares have been on a roller-coaster ride since former direector general Renzo Francesconi resigned earlier this month after challenging the accuracy of the company's first half results statement.
